meta.title: Rail · USDC bridge for Arc Testnet and {others} other testnets
meta.description: Rail moves native USDC between Arc Testnet, Base Sepolia, Ethereum Sepolia and {more} more testnets with Circle CCTP. No wrapped tokens.

hero.lead: Rail burns USDC on the chain you send from and Circle mints the same amount on the chain you send to. No wrapped tokens, no liquidity pools.

progress.title: Transfer progress
progress.desc: Every bridge goes through these four steps. Keep this tab open until the last one is done.
step.approve.title: Approve USDC
step.approve.desc: Lets the Circle bridge contract move this amount from your wallet. Skipped if you already approved enough.
step.burn.title: Burn on {chain}
step.burn.desc: Your USDC is burned on the source chain. This transaction starts the transfer and needs gas there.
step.attestation.title: Waiting for Circle attestation
step.attestation.desc: Circle confirms the burn and signs a receipt. No action needed; usually under a minute, up to about 20 minutes on slower chains.
step.mint.title: Mint on {chain}
step.mint.desc: New native USDC is minted to your address on the destination chain. You confirm this in your wallet and pay its gas.
activity.title: Activity
activity.desc: Transactions from this session, each linked to its block explorer.
activity.emptyText: Your approve, burn and mint transactions will show up here as soon as you start a bridge.
ledger.retryingDetail: The first attempt failed, trying once more
help.title: Need test tokens?
help.desc: Two things are needed: testnet USDC to send and a little gas on both chains.
help.faucetText: Free testnet USDC on most of the chains listed here.
help.gasText: Each chain charges gas in its own coin. On Arc Testnet gas is paid in USDC.
footer.about: An open-source interface for Circle's Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol (CCTP) on testnets. Released under the MIT License.
footer.disclaimer: Testnet only: tokens on these networks have no real value and cannot be sold. Arc Testnet is provided by Circle Technology Services, LLC and is not a regulated financial service. Use Rail at your own risk and never send mainnet funds to a testnet address.
